# FDRBench v1.1.1 reference fixture

`expected.fasta` was generated by the official FDRBench v1.1.1 release binary,
not by `protein_fasta`. The source fixture was inherited from `fdr_benchmark`
revision `bbf582e382833cf8bdc439e69edb287842293b02`.

Release asset:

- URL: `https://github.com/Noble-Lab/FDRBench/releases/download/v1.1.1/fdrbench-1.1.1.zip`
- ZIP SHA-256: `d1740d90decd139c0e2294d766797be800c2b7bd3fd7ae3624e9822ffd7dceed`
- `expected.fasta` SHA-256: `935ae723bd4e1b67f766a34c935e7d2648405ae2239f22eb763cefc11ee53941`

The fixture verifies source/entrapment layout, pairing, length and composition,
fixed peptide termini, digestion boundaries, and collision invariants. Python and
Java use different random-number generators, so shuffled residue bytes are not
expected to match.
